query: 'SELECT
    TRY_CAST(patient_id AS INT) AS patient_id,
    TRIM(CAST(full_name AS NVARCHAR(150))) AS full_name,
    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(TRIM(CAST(gender AS VARCHAR(20)))) IN ('M', 'MALE') THEN 'Male'
        WHEN UPPER(TRIM(CAST(gender AS VARCHAR(20)))) IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 'Female'
        WHEN gender IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(gender AS VARCHAR(20))) = '' THEN 'No Especificado'
        ELSE CONCAT(
            UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(CAST(gender AS VARCHAR(20))), 1)),
            LOWER(SUBSTRING(TRIM(CAST(gender AS VARCHAR(20))), 2, LEN(TRIM(CAST(gender AS VARCHAR(20))))))
        )
    END AS gender,
    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, TRIM(CAST(date_of_birth AS VARCHAR(60))), 23),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, TRIM(CAST(date_of_birth AS VARCHAR(60))), 101),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, TRIM(CAST(date_of_birth AS VARCHAR(60))), 110),
        TRY_PARSE(TRIM(CAST(date_of_birth AS VARCHAR(60))) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
    ) AS date_of_birth,
    CASE
        WHEN phone IS NULL
             OR LOWER(TRIM(CAST(phone AS VARCHAR(50)))) IN ('', 'unknown', 'null', 'n/a', 'none')
            THEN NULL
        ELSE RIGHT(
                REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(phone AS VARCHAR(50))), '-', ''), '(', ''), ')', ''), '.', ''), ' ', ''),
                10
             )
    END AS phone,
    CASE
        WHEN email IS NULL
             OR LOWER(TRIM(CAST(email AS VARCHAR(150)))) IN ('', 'unknown', 'null', 'n/a')
            THEN NULL
        ELSE REPLACE(
                REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(CAST(email AS VARCHAR(150)))), ',com', '.com'),
                '@gmial.com', '@gmail.com'
             )
    END AS email,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(address AS NVARCHAR(255))), N'') AS address,
    CASE
        WHEN insurance_provider IS NULL
             OR TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100))) = N''
            THEN N'No Especificado'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100)))) IN (N'cigna', N'cigna health')
            THEN N'Cigna'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100)))) IN (N'bluecross', N'blue cross')
            THEN N'BlueCross'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100)))) = N'aetna'
            THEN N'Aetna'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100)))) = N'medicaid'
            THEN N'Medicaid'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100)))) = N'medicare'
            THEN N'Medicare'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100)))) = N'uhc'
            THEN N'UHC'
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100)))) IN (N'self pay', N'self-pay', N'selfpay')
            THEN N'Self Pay'
        ELSE CONCAT(
            UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100))), 1)),
            LOWER(SUBSTRING(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100))), 2, LEN(TRIM(CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(100))))))
        )
    END AS insurance_provider
FROM bronze.patients
WHERE patient_id IS NOT NULL
  AND full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(CAST(full_name AS NVARCHAR(150))) <> N''',
gender = case(   lower(trim(gender)) == 'm' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'male', 'Male',   lower(trim(gender)) == 'f' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'female', 'Female',   'No Especificado' ),

phone = iif(   isNull(phone) || length(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', '')) < 10,   toString(null()),   concat(     '(', substring(right(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 10), 1, 3), ') ',     substring(right(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 10), 4, 3), '-',     substring(right(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 10), 7, 4)   ) ),
